description: This file contains test cases for the VoiceWakePreferences component, testing functions like sanitizing trigger words, handling defaults, string display formatting, and persistence through load/save functions.

classes.name: VoiceWakePreferencesTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for VoiceWakePreferences functionalities, including sanitization, defaults, display strings, and persistence.

methods.name: sanitizeTriggerWordsTrimsAndDropsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that sanitizeTriggerWords trims whitespace and drops empty strings.

methods.name: sanitizeTriggerWordsFallsBackToDefaultsWhenEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that sanitizeTriggerWords returns default trigger words when input is all empty or whitespace.

methods.name: sanitizeTriggerWordsLimitsWordLength
methods.description: Ensures that sanitized words do not exceed the maximum allowed length.

methods.name: sanitizeTriggerWordsLimitsWordCount
methods.description: Checks that the number of trigger words does not exceed the maximum limit.

methods.name: displayStringUsesSanitizedWords
methods.description: Confirms that displayString correctly formats sanitized trigger words.

methods.name: loadAndSaveTriggerWordsRoundTrip
methods.description: Tests the load and save functions for trigger words perform a proper round-trip without data loss.
